title: 嘉文四世·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 后梳深发配金色冠状头饰，龙形金甲与蓝布构成明亮层次。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Jarvan IV is an adult Demacian prince with dark swept hair, a golden crown-like headpiece, strong eyebrows, and ornate dragon-inspired gold armor with deep blue cloth. Preserve his fully armored torso, covered legs, gauntlets, and boots with natural heroic adult proportions. His long lance rests upright with its butt grounded, and its blue banner stays gathered rather than raised for a charge.
art_direction.scene: A low three-quarter full-figure study, grounded relaxed stance, clear triangular silhouette and one bright diagonal of sunlight. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: gold, royal blue, pale stone, copper light; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
